evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository and sets only user.name/user.email before committing. It never sets commit.gpgSign=false, so an environment with global commit.gpgSign=true will make `git commit` attempt signing under fixture@example.invalid; if no usable key exists, the baseline commit fails and DeployFixture.setUp errors. Disabling repository-local signing before line 94 is the smallest fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
